environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance running directly behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no additional middleware. The Flask app listens on port 8080, NLB forwards TCP traffic on port 443 directly to the instance. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No request inspection or filtering layer exists between the client and the application. SQLite database contains production user data including admin accounts with elevated roles.
